1. Wait forever to download
2. Launch the game
3. Make an account and configure settings
4. Get randomly forced into a cutscene and the game crashes after lagging horribly for a minute
5. Relaunch the game in safe mode
6. Get instantly forced into cutscene, but there are configuration UIs over it?
7. Game crashes again
8. Launch again in safe mode, do nothing
9. Cutscene finally finishes
10. Reconfigure everything
11. Try to join a friend
12. Crash
13. Relaunch, try to join a friend
14. "You need to buy the game"??? Try to join a friend

17. Relaunch, try to join a friend
18. Get in a round
19. Crash
20. Write a review and go back to Apex Legends with said friend
